difficulty_reason: The conclusion is an equivalence of higher-inductive types with coherent constructor behaviour. Producing only an objectwise map is insufficient; the author derives induction and a path-computation rule before obtaining the inverse maps. This supplies concrete H2 work in univalent homotopy theory.

compared.difference: Suspension connectivity uses a specialized code-family contraction; it does not assert the general total-space/coequalizer equivalence.
Computes0-truncated path groupoids of a pushout; flattening constructs the full dependent total-space higher-inductive type without0-truncation.
Contractibility of a factorization space uses modal images and fibrewise comparison, not this coequalizer flattening theorem.
